votes.motion: A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Zach Robinson, to adopt Ordinance #22-04, an ordinance revising Title 21 of the Sandy City Municipal Code Chapter 19, "Special Development (SD) Districts", Section 26, "SD(R-2-A) Fluckiger District - 1770 E. 11400 S." to amend the requirements of this SD Zone that would allow for total of four single-family lots within the zoned area and other miscellaneous amendments to simplify regulations; also providing a saving clause and effective date for the ordinance

A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Ryan Mecham, to adopt Ordinance #22-06, an ordinance amending and fixing the boundaries of a zone district of the Sandy City Zoning Ordinance; to wit: rezoning approximately 2.5 total acres from IC "Institutional Care District" to RM (12) "Residential Multi-Family District", located at approximately 348 E. 8000 S.; also providing a saving clause and an effective date for the ordinance

A motion was made by Marci Houseman, seconded by Zach Robinson to approve a budget amendment, as detailed in the D'Sousa proposal, increasing the funding for the Sandy Youth Council Program by $3,000, as specified in Exhibit A - Option A

A motion was made by Zach Robinson, seconded by Alison Stroud to approve a budget amendment, as detailed in the Robinson-Stroud proposal, to include the purchase of 3 sets of cordless extrication equipment. In the FY23 budget: $70,000 from the ongoing revenue sources that have been identified by Mr. Kelley and approximately $61,199 taken from the proposed transfer to capital contingency for FY23, instead moving that amount into the equipment management fund for FY23

A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Brooke D'Sousa to approve a budget amendment, as detailed in the Sharkey, D'Sousa, Earl proposal, restoring the full general fund subsidy to the bulk waste program
A motion was made by Cyndi Sharkey, seconded by Scott Earl, to approve the Consent Calendar

A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Scott Earl, to adopt Resolution 22-29C, a resolution increasing total appropriations within the proprietary funds for the fiscal year commencing July 1, 2021 and ending June 30, 2022
A motion was made by Marci Houseman seconded by Zach Robinson to recess the City Council meeting and convene a meeting of the Redevelopment Agency
